reviewer_statement: Author-side six-domain native-language source review against frozen Python 1.2. The full declared validated native R workflow audit record domain matches source 12-column integer-coerced summary schema, raw-type workflow_reporting_text schema formatting, descriptive scientific counts, and exact text in direct Python dataclass oracle tests. Python pandas/dataclass class identity, arbitrary Python objects, and exception class identity remain language-specific. Independent certification is not claimed.
native_language_semantic_policy: Python dataclass WorkflowStepRecord/WorkflowDecisionRecord and generic dataclass workflow result map to explicit validated native R S3 workflow audit record; pandas source data frame maps to R data.frame, Python text to UTF-8 R character scalar. Python int() coercion of version is reproduced for native atomic scalar analogues. Exception class identity and arbitrary Python object protocols are not R semantics.

case_evidence.description: Published Python 1.2 workflow summary and report signatures; source typed dataclass result versus explicit native S3 record boundary
Native schema 1 integer, float, bool and numeric string coercion, zero through 13 ordered steps, four decision provenance categories, valid Unicode identifiers
Direct Python 1.2 oracle tests exact counts for completed, failed, skipped, warnings, decisions and schema coercion across eight scenarios
Invalid workflow record, version, status, selector criterion, nonfinite nested configuration/provenance and empty identifiers are rejected
Exact twelve source summary columns, ordered dataframe row, and byte-for-byte Python f-string reporting text across ASCII, quotes and Unicode
Summary is a descriptive provenance count only; does not execute inference, silently preprocess, select scientific estimators or claim statistical approval
